skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the basic concepts of economic and technical norms.
Students will be able to analyze the methods for calculating economic and technical norms.
Students will learn how to manage the implementation of material consumption levels.
Students will understand the principles and application of ISO 9000 quality management standards.
Students will develop teamwork skills through group activities and presentations.
Students will enhance their critical thinking abilities by analyzing real-world scenarios.
Students will demonstrate self-management skills when working independently.
Students will improve their presentation skills through group presentations.
Students will understand the importance and process of standardization in business operations.
